definition.domain: 4830 ordered distinct (zombieId,humanId) pairs; same-cell starts excluded
definition.neighbor: One in-bounds cardinal human move with zombie fixed; exclude human neighbor equal to zombieId; include initially adjacent terminal starts
definition.witness: Lowest human neighbor ID among maximizers, including all-zero ties; null only if no legal neighbor
definition.edgeCounting: Undirected per fixed zombie, humanAId<humanBId; each edge counted once
